title: Grid mode fits more: no usage footer in app sessions, usage shown in the app, smaller text and header in a grid, no slide-in

requirements.text: Sessions started by the app show no session%/weekly status line; claude outside the app still does
requirements.check: eye: new app session has no usage footer; plain terminal claude still shows it

requirements.text: The user's own statusLine command still runs inside app sessions (usage-latest.json keeps refreshing)
Session %, weekly %, pace and both reset times show in the app's top bar
Terminal font shrinks as more panes are on screen, and returns to 13 with one
In a grid the goal and task strip is one line
requirements.check: eye: grid strip is a single line

requirements.text: Entering grid mode does not slide panes or strips in
requirements.check: eye: clicking the grid button switches without sliding

text: Grid rows and columns share the space evenly
check: eye: 4-pane grid, all four panes the same height

evidence: tests/run.mjs: 435 passed 0 failed, incl. checks that status-line prints nothing, writes usage.json, and runs CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR settings.json statusLine command with identical stdin; manual run with GENLOCK_APP_CHANNEL printed nothing and wrote usage.json

text: Built all 7 reqs: genlock status-line (prints nothing, writes <voice base>/usage.json, runs user's own statusLine), sessionSettings statusLine, UsageMeter in SessionBar+Dashboard, SplitLayout.fontSize, one-line SessionStrip, stacks instead of split views, no spring on grid. swift test 114 pass, node 435 pass. Needs TJ relaunch + eye; existing sessions keep old status line until restarted. Not committed.
